models.pipeline: Hunyuan source -> Blender silhouette-protected decimation and embedded runtime PBR repack; landmark files additionally use glTF-Transform Meshopt and WebP

narrativeProps.source: Tencent Hunyuan 3D 3.0 Normal + PBR, generated from the approved isolated Chapter 3 prop references
narrativeProps.optimization: 500k source triangles per asset reduced to 7k-14k; three 4096px source maps repacked as three embedded 1024px maps
narrativeProps.placement: arrival: queue dispenser and night reader; market: produce scale, handcart and receipt device; transit/scanner: stanchion, clerk stamp, crosswalk signal and PA speaker; fountain: reunion bench

perimeterBuildings.source: Tencent Hunyuan 3D 3.0 Normal + PBR, generated from three isolated project-authored building references
perimeterBuildings.optimization: 466k-498k source triangles reduced to 18k/22k/20k while retaining the generated normal maps; three 4096px source maps repacked as embedded 1024px maps
perimeterBuildings.runtimeTotal: approximately 4.5 MB for three legacy GLB prototypes shared across eleven of the twenty-one street-wall instances
perimeterBuildings.placement: the old two-ring scatter is superseded by one camera-aware street wall: a seven-building north skyline, interrupted side frontages and a deliberately low player-facing south edge

denseDistrictBuildings.source: Tencent Hunyuan 3D 3.0 Normal + PBR, generated from five project-authored isolated Chapter 3 building references
denseDistrictBuildings.cost: 30 points per source plus repair/optimization passes; 150 generation points for the accepted five-model set
denseDistrictBuildings.optimization: source meshes reduced to 18k bakery, 20k pharmacy, 20k printworks, 36k hotel and 32k arcade while preserving roof silhouettes and embedded PBR detail
denseDistrictBuildings.runtimeTotal: approximately 9.65 MB for five shared GLBs; ten runtime instances contribute about 222k geometry triangles before the legacy street wall
denseDistrictBuildings.placement: bakery x3, pharmacy x2 and printworks x3 establish varied repeatable frontages; the Copper Heron Hotel anchors the east frontage and the Civic Night Arcade anchors the far north skyline, while the player-facing south edge remains low
denseDistrictBuildings.visibilityAudit: approved V2 parcel rule: A/B full buildings; C/D/F/H/I low masses; E/G open. All building collisions use measured oriented footprints and every pair retains visible clearance.

transitArchitecture.source: Tencent Hunyuan 3D 3.0 Normal + PBR, generated from two project-authored isolated references
transitArchitecture.optimization: open-air station reduced from 498,210 to 28,000 triangles; tunnel portal reduced from 500,000 to 22,000 triangles; three 4096px source maps per asset repacked as embedded 1024px maps
transitArchitecture.placement: the station sits beside the readable southwest platform; the portal is mounted against the upper-left perimeter building and receives the chapter exit railway

streetDressing.source: Tencent Hunyuan 3D 3.0 Normal + PBR, generated from three isolated text prompts approved for the Chapter 3 street edge
streetDressing.optimization: campfire 497,210 -> 7,998 triangles at 1024px; crushed trash can 499,312 -> 6,000 triangles at 1024px; abandoned compact car 499,364 -> 18,000 triangles at 1536px
streetDressing.runtimeTotal: approximately 5.1 MB for three shared GLBs
streetDressing.placement: one warm campfire in the south activity court; fourteen geometry-sharing crushed cans along building edges; three geometry-sharing wrecked cars occupy the marked paved exits and replace the intersecting northeast fence corner

sunriseOverlook.source: Tencent Hunyuan 3D 3.0 Normal + PBR, generated from the approved isolated text prompt
sunriseOverlook.optimization: 499,844 source triangles reduced to 15,999 triangles; three 4096px maps repacked as embedded 1024px maps; the generated lower rock mass and long braces were removed below the deck mounting lip
sunriseOverlook.placement: normalized to the authored summit footprint with its generated rock substructure sunk into the existing tunnel cliff; the open edge aligns with the final timber-walk approach

distantCity.source: OpenAI built-in image generation, authored specifically for the production camera's 45-degree yaw and 45-48-degree top-down orthographic view
distantCity.status: SUPERSEDED — retained in the repository archive as a reference only; not loaded at runtime and not shipped
distantCity.role: abandoned perspective-backdrop experiment; production now uses a closer locked camera and real world-space paving/buildings only
distantCity.legacy: city-horizon-v01.webp is archived beside it as a superseded reference and is not loaded

railBoundary.reuse: one boardable tram plus two shared-geometry convoy clones; two additional tilted clones form a stacked derelict-car barricade at the northeast street edge
railBoundary.layout: the three service cars remain aligned on the station-to-tunnel railway; the wreck pair is a separate physical boundary that disguises the closed street edge

worn-limestone-source.png.role: project-generated seamless albedo source derived from the approved v6 material language only
worn-limestone-source.png.prompt_scope: orthographic top-down worn civic limestone; no scene layout, objects or baked lighting

ground.worn-limestone-dark-albedo.webp: 1024px dark civic-cobble variant used for broad walkable courts

dark-city-cobbles.webp.role: dark backstage paving used only where west/north facades fully occlude the player
dark-city-cobbles.webp.source: Quaternius Downtown City MegaKit Standard / T_Concrete_Asphalt_BaseColor.png

interaction: A continuous 116x86 visible district underlies a rectilinear three-cross-street/three-spine road hierarchy: every exposed paved gap is raycast-walkable unless occupied by a real prop, tram car or measured oriented building footprint. Parcels E and G are both verified open navigation spaces; the northwest hidden band now stops before the visible tunnel gap. The rail bed itself is crossable; only the three tram bodies block movement. Fully occluded north/backstage strips are visibly darkened and remain non-walkable. The orthographic camera follows the player through a tight dead zone and is clamped to a close 2.4-3.2 zoom range.

profile.geometry: EXT_meshopt_compression (level high: KHR_mesh_quantization, position 14 bit, normal 8 bit, texcoord 12 bit)
profile.textures: EXT_texture_webp, lossy, smart chroma subsampling, effort 6, alpha lossless; near-lossless or lossless when lossy cannot reach minPsnr
